svg.aria-label: A cube face seen edge-on, 1 unit from the centre. The line of sight to a texel on it is d long and meets the face at the angle a from straight on, so seen from the centre the texel looks its area times cos a big; d is the square root of 1 + u squared + v squared, and cos a is 1 / d.
